blocks.text: On the ICe
Luxury Ice Castle Rentals, Day House Rentals & more

From luxury Ice Castle sleeper rentals and brand new day house rentals to tranportation and plow a prep spot services, we do it all.  In the Detroit Lakes area, Baxstar is the only Ice Castle rental company owned and operated by an award winning professional fishing guide and he will put you on fish.

​

We can accommodate groups of all sizes, including families and corporate groups.  Contact us today to plan your next trip on the ice!​

 


All Ice castles listed below include come

*Prices are subject to change
17' Ice Castle Ranger Runner

This is the ultimate luxury ice fishing experience! We have three 17' x 8' rentals available.  They are very similar, offering everything you need!​


​​


Included in the rental:



 
 ​Complimentary clean blankets, sheets, and pillows

 

 
 Complimentary rattle reels for fishing​

 

 
 Complimentary ice auger by request

 

 
 Generator with full tank of gas​

 

 
 Complete kitchenette, including microwave, plates

 

 
 Plastic cutlery, paper plates

 

 
 Flatscreen TV, Antenna, DVD Player & DVDs

 

 
 Private bathroom with door, mounted toilet, toilet paper, garbage bags

 

 
 6-7 holes for fishing (they will be drilled and ready to go)

 

 
 Sleeps up to 6 (we recommend up to 4 people per house)

 



​


Available add ons:   



 
 rods & reels

 

 
 tackle and/or live bait

 

 
 fish finders

 

 
 underwater camera 

 

 
 additional full 5 gallon gas can for refills.  

 



 


Click "Book Now" to view more information, including check in and check out times.


​​

3 days/2 nights: $795

Additional day/night - $250​ (maximum 7 days/6 nights)​


​


Single Night (M-W only): $275 ​


​​


​Add a guide to your rental - Starting at $200 for 2 hours​


​


Customers will be placed in a the 17' house that is available at the time.  


Contact Baxstar to discuss options for choosing a particular house.
